A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the Eddy current loss in the permanent-magnet motors can be reduced by the following methods: 1) the reduction of the carrier harmonics, 2) the reduction of magnet Eddy-current path by reducing the magnet thickness, and 3) the reduction of eddy-current path by dividing the magnet.
the loss reduction in the permanent magnet can be achieved by dividing the magnet into small pieces and by using a carrier frequency that is sufficiently higher than the major harmonic frequency.
the loss reduction in the permanent magnet by the division is not effective for the motors of high power factor and low carrier frequency.
